Subject: Renewal onboarding: capacity onramp & QBR availability

Hi Jane —

Thanks again for the productive call yesterday. Per our conversation, VectorHealth is coming up on renewal and wants to lock in term and burst capacity for H2. I wanted to kick off a short onboarding/renewal thread so we can:

- Align on the mutual action plan (MAP) and dates
- Confirm capacity targets (baseline + seasonal burst lanes)
- Schedule the renewal QBR with execs & ops

Proposed next steps from Redwood:
1) I’ll attach a draft MAP for your review (see attached).
2) David will propose a staffing + capacity timeline that maps to your traffic forecast.
3) We’ll share 2–3 QBR slot options; please flag any conflicts with procurement timelines.

Could you confirm who from your side should be on the QBR invite (execs, security, procurement)? Also, are there hard procurement cutoff dates we should be aware of for June/July?

Attachments: mutual_action_plan_v1.xlsx (draft MAP)

Thanks — looking forward to aligning this week.

—Marissa

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the note and the draft MAP. Quick answers:
- Please include me (Jane Li, VP Ops), our Head of Engineering (cc’d on ops@), and Procurement (procurement@) on the QBR.
- We have a procurement window that closes on 2028-06-20 for any contract amendments that must be in effect by 2028-07-01. If we miss that, approvals push to the next cycle (end of July).
- Baseline throughput is expected to grow ~30% by Sept (new features), and we need a burst path to support seasonal traffic in Nov–Dec.

Reviewing the MAP now — will come back with comments by EOD. If you can propose QBR slots that land before 6/15, that helps our procurement timeline.

—Jane

Subject: Re: Renewal onboarding: capacity onramp & QBR availability

Marissa / team —

Thanks Jane. I pulled together a tentative capacity/staffing timeline and candidate QBR slots based on the 30% growth signal and your procurement cutoff. Key points: 

- Baseline increase: target +30% by 2028-09-15. We recommend a staged ramp: +10% (7/01), +20% (8/01), +30% (9/15) to make sure KV cache hit rates and batching profiles stabilize.
- Burst lanes: add a "seasonal burst" pool provisioned 2 weeks prior to peak; sizing estimate included in the attached sheet.
- Staff/ops: add a dedicated on-call for VectorHealth during the first 90 days after the ramp — we can staff from our Dedicated support pool.

Candidate QBR slots (Pacific):
- Tue 2028-06-06, 10:00–11:30 PT
- Thu 2028-06-08, 13:00–14:30 PT
- Wed 2028-06-14, 09:00–10:30 PT

Attachments: mutual_action_plan_v1.xlsx (updated with dates), qbr_candidate_slots.pdf, redwood-qbr-template.docx

Open items I’d like to resolve before the QBR:
- Procurement: confirmation of final effective date needed by 2028-06-20.
- Security evidence: Jane, does VectorHealth need a SOC2 evidence package before the QBR? We can surface an evidence bundle if required.

If those slots work for Jane + procurement, I’ll draft a calendar invite and a short QBR agenda.

-David

1) QBR slot: Wed 2028-06-14, 09:00–10:30 PT confirmed (we picked the later candidate to give procurement time for internal sign-off). Calendar invite & agenda to follow.

2) Procurement: VectorHealth team — please aim for a signed amendment by 2028-06-20. We’ll queue an expedited DocuSign once procurement confirms final SOW values. (DocuSign placeholder: https://app.docusign.com/link/REDACTED-vec-hv-2028)

3) Security: we will surface the SOC2 evidence bundle before the QBR; Karthik will own the package delivery. Karthik — can you confirm by 5/10 that we have the evidence bundle and a short readout slide?

4) MAP and capacity sizing: David’s attached MAP now includes the staged ramp and a recommended on-call rotation. VectorHealth — please comment on the sizing sheet by 5/09 so we can finalize staff plans.

Attachments referenced: mutual_action_plan_v1.xlsx, qbr_candidate_slots.pdf, redwood-qbr-template.docx

Marissa will run the invite; David will own the agenda, Karthik will own security artifacts. Monica will coordinate the on-call staffing.
